package excelize
import("encoding/json";"fmt";"os";"sort";"testing";"time";"go/ast";"go/parser";"go/token";"strconv")
func TestJavaExcelizeFormatOracle(t *testing.T){
 languages:=map[string]any{};collect:=func(info languageInfo)any{months:=map[int][]string{};for _,abbr:=range []int{3,4,5}{var values []string;for m:=1;m<=12;m++{values=append(values,info.localMonth(time.Date(2000,time.Month(m),1,0,0,0,0,time.UTC),abbr))};months[abbr]=values};return map[string]any{"tags":info.tags,"weekdays":info.weekdayNames,"weekday_abbr":info.weekdayNamesAbbr,"ampm":info.apFmt,"gannen":info.useGannen,"months":months}}
 for key,info:=range supportedLanguageInfo{languages[fmt.Sprint(key)]=collect(info)};aliases:=map[string]any{};for key,info:=range supportedLanguageCodeInfo{aliases[key]=collect(info)}
 currency:=map[string]any{};for key,value:=range currencyNumFmt{currency[fmt.Sprint(key)]=value}
 tables:=map[string]any{"languages":languages,"aliases":aliases,"builtin":builtInNumFmt,"localized_builtin":langNumFmt,"currency":currency,"supported_tokens":supportedTokenTypes,"number_tokens":supportedNumberTokenTypes,"date_tokens":supportedDateTimeTokenTypes,"era_names":japaneseEraNames,"era_symbols":japaneseEraSymbols,"era_starts":japaneseEraYears};tablesBytes,_:=json.Marshal(tables);if err:=os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("WEKNORA_EXCEL_TABLES_OUTPUT"),tablesBytes,0600);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 formats:=map[string]bool{};for _,value:=range builtInNumFmt{formats[value]=true};for _,value:=range currencyNumFmt{formats[value]=true};for _,m:=range langNumFmt{for _,value:=range m{formats[value]=true}};for key:=range supportedLanguageInfo{for _,pattern:=range []string{"mmmm dddd h:mm:ss AM/PM","mmmmm ddd yyyy","ggg e年m月d日"}{formats[fmt.Sprintf("[$-%X]%s",key,pattern)]=true}}
 ordered:=[]string{};for value:=range formats{ordered=append(ordered,value)};sort.Strings(ordered);var rows []any
 values:=[]string{"0","0.1","0.5","1","2.675","-2.675","59.5","60.5","61.5","43543.544872685183","12345.6789","999999.9","1.23456789123457E+17","text"}
 for _,numFmt:=range ordered{for _,value:=range values{for _,date1904:=range []bool{false,true}{rows=append(rows,map[string]any{"value":value,"format":numFmt,"date1904":date1904,"cell_type":int(CellTypeNumber),"expected":format(value,numFmt,date1904,CellTypeNumber,nil)})}}}
 source,err:=parser.ParseFile(token.NewFileSet(),os.Getenv("WEKNORA_EXCELIZE_TEST_SOURCE"),nil,0);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 ast.Inspect(source,func(node ast.Node)bool {fn,ok:=node.(*ast.FuncDecl);if !ok||fn.Name.Name!="TestNumFmt"{return true};table:=fn.Body.List[0].(*ast.RangeStmt).X.(*ast.CompositeLit);for _,elem:=range table.Elts{item:=elem.(*ast.CompositeLit);values:=[]string{};for _,v:=range item.Elts{lit:=v.(*ast.BasicLit);text,e:=strconv.Unquote(lit.Value);if e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)};values=append(values,text)};for _,date1904:=range []bool{false,true}{rows=append(rows,map[string]any{"value":values[0],"format":values[1],"date1904":date1904,"cell_type":int(CellTypeNumber),"expected":format(values[0],values[1],date1904,CellTypeNumber,nil)})}}
 return false})
 for _,typ:=range []CellType{CellTypeNumber,CellTypeDate,CellTypeBool,CellTypeSharedString,CellTypeInlineString,CellTypeError,CellTypeFormula,CellTypeUnset}{for _,code:=range []string{"0.00", "0;[Red]0;0;\"text: \"@","\"literal\"@","0\"kg\"","[$$-409]#,##0.00;[Red]($#,##0.00)","[DBNum1]0.00","0%","yyyy-mm-dd","General"}{for _,value:=range []string{"2.675","-2.675","text","0","-0","NaN","+Inf","-Inf","0x1.8p+1","1_000","1e309","1e-309"}{rows=append(rows,map[string]any{"value":value,"format":code,"date1904":false,"cell_type":int(typ),"expected":format(value,code,false,typ,nil)})}}}
 for _,culture:=range []struct{name string;value CultureName}{{"",CultureNameUnknown},{"en-US",CultureNameEnUS},{"ja-JP",CultureNameJaJP},{"ko-KR",CultureNameKoKR},{"zh-CN",CultureNameZhCN},{"zh-TW",CultureNameZhTW}}{for _,code:=range []string{"[$-F800]yyyy-mm-dd","[$-x-sysdate]yyyy-mm-dd","[$-1010000]yyyy-mm-dd","[$-F400]h:mm:ss","[$-x-systime]h:mm:ss","[$-ja-JP-x-gannen,80]ggge年mm月dd日","gggee/mm/dd","yyyy-mm-dd","[$-411]ggg e mm/dd","[$-404]ggg e mm/dd"}{for _,value:=range []string{"0","1","43557","43557.5","44562.189571759256"}{opts:=&Options{CultureInfo:culture.value,LongDatePattern:"dddd mmmm d, yyyy",LongTimePattern:"hh:mm:ss AM/PM"};rows=append(rows,map[string]any{"value":value,"format":code,"date1904":false,"cell_type":int(CellTypeNumber),"options":map[string]string{"culture":culture.name,"longDate":opts.LongDatePattern,"longTime":opts.LongTimePattern},"expected":format(value,code,false,CellTypeNumber,opts)})}}}
 bytes,_:=json.Marshal(rows);if err:=os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("WEKNORA_EXCEL_FORMAT_OUTPUT"),bytes,0600);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};t.Logf("%d language infos, %d named aliases, %d formats × %d values × 2 dates = %d actual format rows",len(languages),len(aliases),len(ordered),len(values),len(rows))
}
